current_role: U.S. senator from Georgia (since 2021; re-elected November 2026)
summary: Jon Ossoff (born 1987), a former documentary filmmaker and investigative journalist, won Georgia's 2021 Senate runoff to become the first millennial senator. He won re-election in November 2026 over Republican Rep. Mike Collins despite a record $44 million Senate Leadership Fund effort against him, and clips of his speeches made him a national Democratic favorite for 2028, though he says he will not run.
